name: com.curbslot/curbslot-mcp
description: Geo-clustered mobile detailing slots, 201-model SUV/truck pricing guardrails, and route-fill.

tools.name: check_geo_clustered_slots
tools.description: Check real-time 18-minute dynamic-anchor geo-clustered booking availability and exact SUV/truck-adjusted pricing for any CurbSlot mobile auto detailer. Blocks cross-town hauls and suggests nearby or next open dates.

shop_slug.description: CurbSlot shop slug (e.g. "apex-scottsdale", "biscayne-gloss", "harbour-shine", or any slug created via create_quick_demo_shop).

date_local.description: Target local date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 2026-11-27 if omitted).

address.description: Customer driveway address or neighborhood name (e.g. "Arcadia, Phoenix, AZ" or "Queen Creek, AZ").

lat.description: Optional latitude coordinate for exact driveway routing.

lng.description: Optional longitude coordinate for exact driveway routing.

service_id.description: Optional service ID from the shop menu (defaults to the shop flagship full detail).

vehicle_model.description: Optional vehicle year/make/model (e.g. "2024 Ford F-150", "Chevy Suburban") for automatic 4-tier sizing & labor pricing.

tools.name: check_vehicle_tier_pricing
tools.description: Run CurbSlot's 165-model US & Australian vehicle sizing guardrail to return the exact detailing tier (1–4), default price delta, duration delta, and whether an under-selected tier (e.g. Sedan for an F-150 or Suburban) is auto-upgraded.

vehicle_model.description: Free-text vehicle description (e.g. "2024 Ford F-150", "Chevy Suburban", "2024 Toyota HiLux", "Honda Civic").

selected_tier.description: Optional customer-selected tier (1=Coupe/Sedan, 2=2-Row SUV/Small Truck, 3=3-Row SUV/Half-Ton Truck, 4=XL SUV/HD Truck/Van). Defaults to 1.

tools.name: get_neighbor_fill_candidates
tools.description: Inspect a detailer's clustered route for today and retrieve nearby past clients within the shop's drive-time cluster to fill an afternoon gap with 1-tap Neighbor Route-Fill SMS links.

tools.name: create_quick_demo_shop
tools.description: Spin up a live, branded CurbSlot sandbox preview (https://curbslot.com/demo/<slug>) seeded with services, a 9:00 AM anchor job, and nearby past clients in 1 call.

name.description: Mobile detailing business name (e.g. "Sunbelt Ceramic Mobile Detailing").

max_cluster_mins.description: Maximum inter-job drive time in minutes (default: 18).

deposit_dollars.description: Upfront no-show protection deposit in dollars (default: 50).
